name: JBVNL Data Recovery Centre Jamshedpur
notes: Utility-owned disaster-recovery data centre in Jamshedpur (East Singhbhum) operated by state power distribution company JBVNL; small enterprise/government DR facility, no commercial colocation.

name: Jharkhand State Data Centre (JHSDC)
notes: State-government data centre in Ranchi (Birsa Nagar/CTI Colony area) hosting state department applications; public-sector/government SDC, not commercial colocation. NIC Jharkhand state centre co-located in Ranchi.

name: JBVNL Central Data Center and Call Center Ranchi
notes: Utility central data centre and customer call centre established in Ranchi under JBVNL's urban power distribution programme; government/utility facility.

name: NTT DATA Bengaluru 4 (BLR4) Campus
developer: NTT Global Data Centers / NTT DATA
notes: NTT's Bengaluru 4 campus at Prestige Tech Cloud, Devanahalli (Bangalore Rural district): 3 data centres x 22.4 MW IT load each = 67.2 MW critical IT design, ~100 MW campus, 220 kV GIS substation; officially opened June 2026 as Bengaluru's largest DC campus.

name: KIADB Tavarekere Data Centre Park (300-acre)
developer: Karnataka Industrial Areas Development Board (KIADB) / Government of Karnataka
notes: Dedicated data centre park at Tavarekere industrial area bordering Hoskote and Kolar; KIADB to acquire 1,000 acres with 250-300 acres for DC park; hub-and-spoke model with GW-scale hub linked to 25-30 MW edge DCs; part of Karnataka's ~1 GW data park plan (Bengaluru/Mysuru/Mangaluru).

name: STT Bengaluru DC3
notes: Tier III data centre in Whitefield, six-storey IGBC Green Building, 18 MW IT load; opened as STT GDC India's 15th facility (2022).

name: STT Bengaluru DC2
notes: STT Bengaluru DC2 in Whitefield, ~7 MW, operational since ~2022 per aggregator; presence corroborated by STT official Bengaluru locations page.

name: CtrlS Bengaluru (Electronic City)
notes: Rated-4 LEED Platinum data centre in Electronic City Phase I; 12 MW IT load, 2,000+ racks, ~106,536 sq ft raised floor.

name: Sify Bengaluru Data Centre
notes: Carrier-neutral Tier III facility, 4.82 MW IT power, dual Meet-Me-Rooms; enterprise colocation and hybrid cloud.

name: Nxtra Bangalore Data Centre (Whitefield)
notes: Nxtra hyperscale-ready colocation at EPIP Zone, Whitefield Road (Bengaluru Urban); operator reports 230+ MW footprint across India and 8 major markets; exact BLR site capacity not published.

name: Datasamudra AI Data Centre Mangaluru
developer: Datasamudra (unnamed Bengaluru company per state sources)
notes: Planned 35-40 MW AI-focused data centre in Mangaluru with Rs 300-500 crore investment, announced as part of Karnataka's Rs 13.5 billion data centre investment package (Dec 2025); trade press reports name Datasamudra as developer; MoU/announcement stage, no permit trail verified.

name: Mangaluru Data Centre Park (350-acre)
notes: Mangaluru park on ~350 acres identified, part of Karnataka's three-city sustainable data centre parks plan with combined ~1 GW capacity (Bengaluru, Mysuru, Mangaluru); green power and treated-water design; planning stage.

name: Mangaluru Data Centre Feasibility Study (KDEM/Deloitte)
developer: Karnataka Digital Economy Mission (KDEM), Deloitte India, Silicon Beach Program
notes: 2025 feasibility study flags Mangaluru as India's next major coastal data-centre hub (twin-hub strategy with Bengaluru, Mangaluru and Hubballi as regional edge nodes); study-stage evidence of market development, not a facility.
